breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting instructions. The ground truth correctly removed the erroneous line "time_integration: Explicit forward Euler." because the detailed Strang splitting method is the intended solver. The agent, however, kept the reference to Forward Euler and tried to incorrectly reconcile the conflict by adding the sentence: "Use explicit forward Euler only for the splitting framework as described; no additional time integration method is required." This is incorrect, as the specified Strang splitting method does not use Forward Euler for its sub-steps (it uses exact Fourier and pointwise solutions). The agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction instead of removing it.
